description: This file defines a custom report class for generating employee timesheet XML reports in an Odoo module, including functions for date calculations, XML generation, and report rendering.

classes.name: report_custom
classes.description: A custom report class for generating employee timesheet XML reports, extending report_rml.

methods.name: get_month_name
methods.description: Returns the localized name of a given month.

methods.name: get_weekday_name
methods.description: Returns the localized name of a given weekday.

methods.name: create_xml
methods.description: Generates the XML report for employee timesheets over a specified month.
